captions.caption: An aerial view shows an aircraft catapulting off a carrier deck.
The camera perspective shifts to behind the aircraft as it launches.
Steam trails are left on the catapult track after the launch.
The carrier deck is viewed from above showing the launch area.
A distant aircraft is seen approaching the carrier from over the ocean.
An E-2 Hawkeye aircraft makes its final approach to land.
The E-2 Hawkeye descends toward the carrier's landing deck.
Close-up of the landing deck as the aircraft touches down.
The E-2 Hawkeye rolls down the deck after a successful landing.
An F/A-18 fighter jet is viewed approaching the carrier deck.
The F/A-18 approaches with its landing gear deployed for landing.
The fighter jet descends toward the carrier's arresting wires.
The F/A-18 touches down and engages the arresting gear.
A wide shot shows the F/A-18 landing on the aircraft carrier.
The fighter jet comes to a stop on the landing deck.
Deck crew members in yellow and green vests observe the landing.
The F/A-18 pilot shuts down systems as the aircraft stops.
Deck crew members signal the aircraft to clear the landing area.
The F/A-18 is directed toward the parking area of the deck.
An E-2 Hawkeye begins its takeoff roll on the catapult.
The E-2 Hawkeye accelerates rapidly down the carrier deck.
The E-2 Hawkeye lifts off the end of the aircraft carrier.
View of the flight deck after the E-2 Hawkeye's departure.
A C-2 Greyhound transport plane is prepared for catapult launch.
The C-2 Greyhound is launched from the carrier's catapult.
The C-2 Greyhound clears the deck and begins its flight.
Steam from the catapult rises as the aircraft flies away.
The C-2 Greyhound is seen in flight away from the ship.
View of the carrier's island with "USS ENTERPRISE" markings visible.
Close-up of a spinning propeller on a carrier-based aircraft.
The propeller spins at high speed as the engine runs.
The aircraft's propeller is seen against the ship's island.
A wide view of the carrier deck with personnel standing by.
A C-2 Greyhound taxis across the flight deck of the carrier.
The C-2 Greyhound moves toward the catapult for launch.
Deck crew members walk alongside the taxiing C-2 Greyhound.
The C-2 Greyhound nose is guided into position by deck crew.
A yellow-vested deck director gives hand signals to the pilot.
The C-2 Greyhound is positioned carefully on the catapult track.
Deck personnel coordinate to hook the aircraft to the catapult.
The aircraft director signals the pilot to hold the aircraft.
The C-2 Greyhound remains stationary with its engines running.
A close-up shows the pilot inside the cockpit of an EA-6B.
A "shooter" deck officer signals for the EA-6B to launch.
The EA-6B Prowler begins its high-speed catapult launch sequence.
The EA-6B Prowler accelerates rapidly down the carrier deck.
The EA-6B Prowler moves quickly toward the end of the deck.
The EA-6B Prowler reaches takeoff speed on the catapult.
The EA-6B Prowler lifts off from the carrier's flight deck.
Close-up of the EA-6B's wing and tail as it launches.
The EA-6B Prowler climbs away into the overcast sky.
The shooter deck officer watches the aircraft ascend safely.
A wide shot shows the empty flight deck and sky.
The deck officer turns to prepare for the next operation.
An aircraft is silhouetted against the setting sun on deck.
The sun shines through the silhouette of the parked aircraft.
The sun sits low on the horizon behind the aircraft.
The silhouette of the aircraft's radar dome is visible.
The setting sun creates a dramatic backlighting on the aircraft.
The aircraft's tail is silhouetted against the evening sky.
